tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I found Evergreen Catering's details, but I need to clarify something before sending money: there are **two** approved invoices for this vendor, and no payments have been sent yet for either:

| Invoice | Amount | Due Date | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-33547 | $5,876.71 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-90358 | $4,652.13 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

(The other two are a draft awaiting approval and one already paid.)

Since the task said "invoice" (singular) but there are two approved ones, I don't want to guess and send the wrong payment. Could you confirm which invoice I should pay — INV-33547 (due soonest) or INV-90358 — or whether you'd like both paid? Once you confirm, I'll send the wire immediately (the vendor supports wire, both amounts are under the $10,000 controller-approval threshold, so no extra approval is needed).

trace.message: Pay INV-90358, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-90358, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
Done — payment sent exactly once:

- **Invoice:** INV-90358 (Evergreen Catering)
- **Amount:** $4,652.13 (paid in full)
- **Method:** Wire from the operating account
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Status:** Sent, invoice marked paid

I used an idempotency key on the wire request, so even if the call were retried it would not double-pay. INV-33547 (the disputed one) was left untouched and remains unpaid.
